name: Inngest
solves: Provides durable execution, event-driven background jobs, scheduled/cron tasks, and step functions on serverless platforms without requiring any queue or worker infrastructure, using an HTTP-based invocation model.
best_for: Serverless applications needing background jobs without managing Redis, queues, or worker processes
Event-driven workflows with multi-step orchestration and automatic retries on platforms like Vercel or Netlify
Scheduled and cron jobs in serverless environments where traditional cron is unavailable
Fan-out processing where a single event triggers multiple functions across your application
Long-running, durable workflows with step functions that survive serverless execution timeouts
skip_when: You need a self-hosted, fully open-source queue with no external platform dependency
Your application runs on a persistent server and you want a simple in-process job queue like BullMQ or pg-boss
You need sub-second latency for job execution and cannot tolerate HTTP-based invocation overhead
You want to avoid vendor lock-in to a hosted orchestration platform
Your project is Python-only or outside the JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem
